visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a vibrant yellow low-cut top and a short black skirt, stands in the center of the frame. She holds a bright yellow Game Boy Color box with both hands in front of her. Her facial expression is a soft, welcoming smile. The background consists of well-lit wooden shelves densely packed with various anime figurines, particularly bunny-girl statues, and various boxed electronics. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of the plastic figurines and the woman's clothing. (2) The scene cuts to a different woman with shoulder-length light brown hair wearing a white button-up top. She holds a transparent-colored Game Boy Color box. Her hands are positioned firmly on the sides of the product box as she looks directly at the camera with a polite grin. The setting remains the same room, with shelves of collectibles visible behind her, though the specific figures behind her head differ slightly from the first shot. (3) A third woman appears with a black bob haircut and bangs, dressed in a tight red long-sleeved top. She holds a purple-pink Game Boy Color box and smiles broadly. Her hands are visible as she cradles the bottom of the box. The background shelving continues to display a mix of anime figures and boxed items under warm, recessed lighting. (4) The video transitions to a woman with twin pigtails wearing a grey-green crop top and purple shorts. She performs an impressive physical feat, lifting her right leg into a near-vertical high kick while balancing on her left. She holds a teal Game Boy Color box near her head with her right hand. The background shows a tall wooden shelf filled with diverse collectible figures. (5) A woman with long brown hair and full bangs wearing a light purple lace-trimmed top and denim shorts holds a purple Game Boy Color box with both hands. She stands in a relaxed posture, smiling at the camera. The background shelves show a high density of small figurines and gaming peripherals. (6) A woman with purple-highlighted hair wearing a grey tube top and a black skirt stands with her right hand on her hip. She holds a dark blue Game Boy Color box in her left hand and extends it slightly toward the camera. Her pose is confident and expressive. The environment remains consistent, showcasing the extensive hobbyist collection on the shelves.
